summary: Author skills so procedure is conditional rather than mandatory, following Anthropic's official skill authoring best practices: match 'degrees of freedom' to task fragility (reserve exact step sequences for fragile operations only), use the conditional-workflow pattern with explicit decision points instead of unconditional checklists, phrase verification and pipeline steps as applicable-when rather than always-do, keep SKILL.md concise (every line is a recurring per-turn token cost; body under 500 lines), and move task-specific checklists, examples, and heavy recipes into lazy-loaded reference files via progressive disclosure. This directly targets the causal mechanism identified in arXiv 2608.11888 — skills turning optional validation checklists and construction recipes into mandatory work — and the paper's cost-aware packaging recommendation ('move task-specific examples or checklists to lazy-loaded references') matches the official guidance. Scoping activation (specific when-to-use descriptions; `paths` frontmatter in Claude Code) further limits the tasks on which the procedure loads at all.

evidence.summary: Prescribes conciseness ('Does this paragraph justify its token cost?'), degrees of freedom matched to fragility, conditional workflow pattern, progressive disclosure with <500-line SKILL.md and one-level-deep references, and flexible vs strict templates.
States loaded skill content is a recurring token cost per turn; documents `paths` frontmatter to restrict automatic activation to matching files.

Identifies mandatory-ification of optional checklists as a main efficiency-regression cause and recommends lazy-loaded references and preventing optional guidance from becoming mandatory work — converging with the official authoring guidance.
Community skill collections operationalize the same guidance as skill-authoring review material (hypothesis-level corroboration).

requires: authoring or reviewing Agent Skills whose body contains procedures, checklists, or verification steps
ability to edit the skill source
not_for: fragile operations where a fixed sequence is genuinely required (official guidance assigns these low freedom deliberately)
regressions caused purely by wrong-skill triggering rather than skill content

revalidate_when: Anthropic materially updates skill authoring best practices
Agent Skill runtime changes how skill bodies persist in context
new research contradicts conditional phrasing as a mitigation
risks: No quantitative published measurement of how much conditional phrasing reduces regression incidence; effect on a given skill must be confirmed by RMD-SKILLEFF-002-style evaluation
Over-relaxing steps can reintroduce quality failures the procedure was meant to prevent
